fact.en: Assumption that the 'Golden Age' meant high taxation; in reality, tax rates were relatively moderate compared to Mauryan times.
fact.hi: Assumption that the 'Golden Age' meant high taxation; in reality, tax rates were relatively moderate compared to Mauryan times.

fact.en: Confusing 'Agrahara' (land grants to Brahmins) with 'Devadana' (grants to temples); distinguish these clearly.
fact.hi: Confusing 'Agrahara' (land grants to Brahmins) with 'Devadana' (grants to temples); distinguish these clearly.

fact.en: Assuming a fully money-based economy; the Gupta period saw an increase in land-based transactions and a decline in gold coin circulation in the later stages.
fact.hi: Assuming a fully money-based economy; the Gupta period saw an increase in land-based transactions and a decline in gold coin circulation in the later stages.
